gloss: fist; a knock on the head

definitions.gloss: fist; a knock on the head with the fist
definitions.explanation: A clenched fist used to hit someone, or a blow with it, especially a rap on the head given as a scolding.

examples.japanese: ⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{拳骨|げんこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I got a knock on the head from my father for being mischievous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧{拳骨|げんこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: The teacher gave the student a light rap on the head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おじさん→おじさん：00803_ojisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{拳骨|げんこつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: In the old days, if you did something bad, even the neighborhood men would scold you with a knock on the head.

notes:
Often written in kana, げんこつ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {拳骨|げんこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ / {食|く}らう: to get a knock on the head
- {拳骨|げんこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to rap someone on the head (as a scolding)
- {拳骨|げんこつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{殴|なぐ}る→殴る：02378_naguru⟧: to hit with the fist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{拳|こぶし}→拳：05855_kobushi⟧: fist — the neutral word for the closed hand itself. {拳骨|げんこつ} brings to mind hitting, usually as a punishment.
